text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Developers write unit tests to check small parts of code, and integration tests to make sure different parts work together. Many teams use test-driven development, where they write tests before the actual code. This approach helps catch problems early and keeps the design simple. When tests pass, developers feel more confident about their work. They can change code without fear of breaking something important. In short, testing is not just about finding bugs. It gives teams the confidence to improve their software quickly and safely.
